title: GWT Ablation Dashboard
description: Fill in run ids from ablation experiments. Each condition should contain multiple controlled runs, preferably the same five difficulty-2 map variants.

levels.label: Agent Lesion
levels.description: Disable one module at a time while keeping map, task, scoring, and backend fixed.

conditions.label: Disable perception
conditions.expected_effect: Motor loses global target/map broadcasts; success should drop.

conditions.label: Disable motor
conditions.expected_effect: Movement should disappear; success should drop.

conditions.label: Disable language
conditions.expected_effect: Autonomous foraging should remain close to baseline without prompt intervention.

levels.label: Workspace Gating
levels.description: Change ignition, decay, or maintenance behavior.

conditions.label: Strict workspace-only
conditions.expected_effect: Fewer automatic motor moves; more waiting when no broadcast is actionable.

conditions.label: Non-workspace motor on
conditions.expected_effect: Reference throughput for the automatic/local motor route.

levels.label: Attention / Importance
levels.description: Sweep salience, relevance, and module score multipliers.

conditions.label: Salience only
conditions.expected_effect: Winner selection should follow input change more than task relevance.

conditions.label: Relevance only
conditions.expected_effect: Winner selection should follow task/broadcast semantics more than local change.

levels.label: Broadcast / Bridge
levels.description: Test whether language-to-motor top-down instructions really travel through workspace.

conditions.label: Language bridge on
conditions.manipulation: Allow language instruction_* fields to survive workspace broadcast.
conditions.expected_effect: Prompted navigation should influence later motor planning.

conditions.label: Language bridge off
conditions.manipulation: Strip instruction_* fields before they reach motor.
conditions.expected_effect: Prompted navigation should not influence movement.

levels.label: Environment Perturbation
levels.description: Vary map layout, obstacles, and initial placement.
